Making Figures

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggheatmap)
plots <- list() 
for (i in seq(4)) {
  plots[[i]] <- ggheatmap(as.data.frame.matrix(round(prop.table(ccCountHashSubReg[,,i], 2)*100, 1)), orderCol = F, colorPalette = "PuRd")
}
do.call(grid.arrange, c(plots, ncol = 2))
```
